title: The Sliding Ladder
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: A 10-ft ladder leans against a vertical wall. If the base slides away from the wall at 2 ft/s, how fast is the top of the ladder sliding down when the base is 6 ft from the wall?

steps.title: State Pythagorean Relation
steps.explanation: Let x be distance from wall to base, y be height of top on wall.

steps.title: Differentiate with Respect to Time t
steps.explanation: Ladder length 10 is constant, so its derivative is zero.

steps.title: Substitute and Solve for dy/dt
steps.explanation: The negative sign confirms the top of the ladder is moving downwards.
steps.why: Negative rate corresponds to decreasing vertical distance.
